name: My training (Intervals.icu)
description: Read-only access to your own Intervals.icu data: activities, wellness, calendar, and fitness. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in your local time.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: List my activities between two dates (oldest required, newest optional). Use limit and fields (e.g. id,start_date_local,type,name,moving_time,icu_training_load) to keep the response small.

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Find my activities by name or tag (q).

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get one activity by its id (from list_activities). Set intervals=true to include the interval breakdown.

tools.name: get_activity_streams
tools.description: Get an activity's time-series data. Pass types (e.g. watts,heartrate,cadence) to fetch only what you need; streams are large.

tools.name: list_wellness
tools.description: List my daily wellness records (HRV, resting HR, sleep, weight, fitness/fatigue/form) between oldest and newest.

tools.name: list_calendar
tools.description: List my calendar between oldest and newest: planned workouts, races, notes. Filter with category (e.g. WORKOUT,RACE_A).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get my athlete profile and sport settings (FTP, threshold pace and HR, zones).

tools.name: get_training_summary
tools.description: Get my training summary by week between start and end: totals, load, and time in zones.
